Iliana's Almanac

The cheat coupons installed in this server and the event calendar it runs, month by month.

Coupon codesEvent calendarAlways on

Coupon codes

Type a code in the game's coupon box. The reward arrives as a coupon mail, so claim it from your mailbox. Most codes are reusable: type the same code again to redeem the reward again. SKIPALL is a toggle: it turns the 1.5× minimum of the home Skip off, and back on.

Event calendar

Every event as the server schedules it, in UTC. Pick a bar to see its rewards.

Always on

These run all the time or on their own cycle, so they are not on the calendar.

Built from the served Event.csv rotation and the coupon table of this server. Art and icons: in-game assets.
